description: Frontend Interview Report Page - Display complete interview summary with overall score, interview metadata, per-question breakdown showing question/answer/evaluation, and recommendations section. Provides navigation to start new interview or view history.
steps: Import: useParams, useState, useEffect, api, Navbar, icons from lucide-react (Trophy, Calendar, Clock, Briefcase, Target), RecommendationCard from components
State: report (object with interview, questions array, recommendations), loading (boolean), error (string)
useEffect on mount: GET /interviews/:id/report, setReport(response.data.data), handle errors with setError, setLoading(false)
Report structure validation: verify report.interview.status === 'COMPLETED', if not show 'Interview not completed yet' message with link back to interview room

Display sections: 1) Hero section with overall score (large, color-coded using ScoreCard logic), interview metadata (job role, type, difficulty, date, duration calculated from startedAt to completedAt), 2) Statistics summary cards (total questions, average score, time per question), 3) Question-by-question breakdown accordion/list, 4) Recommendations section using RecommendationCard component

Question breakdown item: each question shows questionNumber, questionCategory badge, questionText (expandable if long), 'Your Answer' section with answerText (expandable with 'Show more' if > 200 chars), evaluation with score badge, feedback text, strengths list (green checkmarks), weaknesses list (amber alerts)
Recommendations section: render RecommendationCard with report.recommendations[0] data (strengths, weaknesses, topicsToImprove, overallFeedback)

Action buttons at bottom: 'Start New Interview' button (primary, indigo) links to /interview/setup, 'Interview History' button (secondary, outline) links to /history, 'Download Report' button (future enhancement, show as disabled with tooltip 'Coming soon')
Loading state: show full-page skeleton with shimmer effect while report loads
Error state: if GET fails show error card with retry button
Styling: gradient hero section for score, white cards for each section, responsive grid for statistics, smooth scrolling between sections, print-friendly layout (optional @media print styles)
Layout: Navbar + main with max-w-6xl container
acceptance_criteria: Report page loads full interview data including questions, answers, evaluations, recommendations
Overall score displayed prominently with correct color coding
Interview metadata shows all relevant information (role, type, difficulty, dates)
Each question displays with answer and evaluation details
Recommendations section shows all 4 data types (strengths, weaknesses, topics, feedback)
Action buttons navigate to correct routes
Page only accessible for COMPLETED interviews (shows error for IN_PROGRESS)
Loading and error states handled gracefully
Page is responsive and visually consistent with dashboard
verification: Complete a full interview (answer all questions, trigger completion)
Verify overall score matches calculated average of evaluation scores
Verify all questions appear in breakdown with answers and evaluations
Verify recommendations section displays (check both successful AI response and fallback case)
Click 'Start New Interview', verify navigation to /interview/setup
Test direct URL access to report of IN_PROGRESS interview, verify error message displays
